run_gtest_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_behavior: test that the GTestHelpTest class verifies correct help message output when help flags are specified
test_non_help_flag_behavior: test that GTestHelpTest runs tests normally and suppresses help message when no help flag is given
test_help_with_various_flags: test help output with full flag, short flag, question mark, and Windows-style question mark flags
test_incorrect_flag_style_help: test that incorrect flag variants like single dash or forward slash still trigger help output
